death.attack.froggydude.devoured: %1$s was torn apart and eaten by %2$s
froggydude.manhunt.title: MANHUNT
froggydude.manhunt.goal.speedrun: Kill the dragon before he gets you
froggydude.manhunt.win.dragon: The Ender Dragon is dead. FroggyDude starves.
froggydude.dev.world: [FroggyDude] Dev world (-dev): the brain reports what it learns in chat.
froggydude.gore.off.desc: No blood and no torn bodies. The cutscene still plays, but the screen goes black on the ugly parts.
froggydude.gore.light.desc: Small splashes. No pools, no blood on skins or on the screen.
froggydude.gore.medium.desc: Blood in the air and on the ground, stains on whoever hit; screen blood only on big hits.
froggydude.gore.heavy.desc: Everything: sprays, big pools, blood on skins and on the screen, arms and head torn off.
froggydude.gore.extreme.desc: Blood gushes for real and only washes off your skin in water or rain (the water turns red). After he kills you, he eats your body and plays with it.
froggydude.warning.title: ⚠ WARNING ⚠
froggydude.warning.line1: This mod has GRAPHIC VIOLENCE: blood, arms and heads torn off, people eaten alive. It may be disturbing.
froggydude.warning.line2: Pick how much of it you want to see. Mobs bleed when you hit them too (except the bloodless ones, like skeletons and slimes).
froggydude.warning.line3: You can change it later in Mods > Froggydude > Config.
froggydude.extreme.title: Warning ⚠
froggydude.extreme.question: This mod will contain heavy scenes. Do you want to continue?
froggydude.extreme.line1: On Extreme blood gushes, sticks to your skin and only washes off in water or rain - and the water turns red where it washed.
froggydude.extreme.line2: When FroggyDude kills you, your body stays on the ground. He eats it. He finds it delicious. And he plays with what is left.
froggydude.settings.title: Froggydude - Settings
froggydude.ai.min.desc: Slow-witted: short sight, slow reactions, runs at your back without predicting, never flanks, never builds or breaks in, picks tactics at random.
froggydude.ai.medio.desc: Half-predicts where you are going, breaks in and builds, but never flanks or sabotages. Learns from you slowly.
froggydude.ai.alto.desc: The usual FroggyDude: shortest path, cuts you off, flanks, builds, breaks in, sabotages the portal and learns how you play.
froggydude.ai.extra.desc: Sees and smells farther, reacts faster, cuts off even sprint-jumpers, zigzags when you aim a bow and walks around your shield.
froggydude.ai.max.desc: Everything from Extra, farther and faster. Barely gambles on what failed against you and never loses the trail. Good luck.
